Section 3.3 Appraisal Rights
Except with the prior written consent of Parent, the Company shall not make any payment with respect to any demands for appraisal or settle or offer to settle any such demands for appraisal. If a holder fails to perfect, withdraws or loses the right to appraisal, such shares shall be deemed to have been converted into the right to receive the Merger Consideration.
